prompt:
Create a breathtaking photorealistic cinematic video of a adult woman exploring a hidden green paradise surrounded by enormous emerald mountains.

She wears a simple short white summer dress with thin straps and a soft flowy skirt, white sandals, and naturally flowing long hair. Keep her face and appearance consistent.

Start directly with a huge panoramic valley view lush green mountains, countless massive fluffy clouds floating between the peaks, waterfalls, mist, tiny flower-covered houses, streams, flowers and warm sunlight. She looks around and says: “This place is unreal…”

She slowly walks along a natural path while the wide camera shows the full scenery waterfalls, sparkling streams, flowers, tiny houses, giant trees, mountains and clouds. She says: “It feels like a dream.”

Camera rises into an epic aerial reveal, pulling far away until she becomes tiny. Show the entire enormous valley, endless green mountains, huge clouds, waterfalls, village, streams and golden sunlight. She says: “I could stay here forever.”

Style: Ultra-realistic, cinematic, dreamy but believable, realistic clouds, water, mist, greenery and sunlight, smooth camera movement, natural human motion, breathtaking scale, premium cinematic quality, 16:9, 4K, no close-ups, no text, no watermark.

translations.zh: 创作一段令人叹为观止的写实电影感视频：一名成年女性探索被巨大翡翠山峦环绕的隐秘绿色仙境。她身穿简约白色细带吊带夏装短裙与白色凉鞋，留着自然披散的长发。画面以壮阔的全景山谷开场，有翠绿山峰、浮云、瀑布、薄雾、花草掩映的小屋与溪流，随后镜头展示她沿小径漫步，最后升起拉远呈现宏大壮丽的全景山谷，并配有相应独白。
translations.en: Create a breathtaking photorealistic cinematic video of a woman exploring an emerald mountain valley paradise. She wears a white summer dress and walks along a scenic path among waterfalls, streams, and village houses, culminating in an epic aerial reveal with spoken dialogue.
